environment.timing_policy: Sequential warm-cache replays with no compilation/test jobs during timing. All observed times and first-launch overhead retained; no confidence interval or equal-work cross-architecture claim.

input_manifest.title: MgSiO3 enstatite calibration crystal in a diamond-anvil cell
input_manifest.purpose: exposed development and regression data; complete workflow validation pending

redistribution.policy: Keep raw frames, source/reference files and derived observations external; no automatic download or upload.

raw_array.historical_orientation: vertical flip; preserve explicit coordinate convention

search_inputs.provenance: Cell, symmetry and wavelength transcribed from supplied source CIF; elements from declared sample. These are supplied priors, not blind indexing results. Coordinates, ADPs and atom counts are forbidden search inputs.

source_hkl_conversion.policy: Use reflection block through the first exact zero-index terminator; reject malformed/nonzero terminator intensity or sigma; archive trailer separately without parsing it as solver input.
source_hkl_conversion.reason: The supplied HKL appends SHELX instructions, including atomic model information, after the terminator. The strict public reader correctly rejects the unsplit file.

derived_observations.name: ours-own-sigma-observations.npz
derived_observations.origin: 2026-10-29 enstatite-from-raw-sensor-refit; previously calibrated and assigned raw-count rerun
derived_observations.qualification: An existing PhaseSmith reduction under fixed historical geometry/assignments; not a fresh end-to-end run.

assessment.reference_atom_count_use: post-search grading only; never used to set maximum_atoms

capacity_preflight.scope: Both source reflection block and archived PhaseSmith-reduced observations; unchanged corpus resource_atom_cap policy.

standalone_comparison.qualification: Same complete signed native measurement rows used for SHELXT export, in original native precision. Input corrected intensities; no raw reduction. Native assesses all metric settings and infers intensity symmetry; SHELXT receives inferred mmm. Different coverage/objectives/architectures. Archives included in native process time.

shelxt_comparison.source: Same 4844 signed v33-v37 native observations; fixed-width export identical to previous comparison. Neutral TITLE; cell/elements and inferred mmm; dummy UNIT 1 1 1; no exact group, formula, counts or coordinates.
shelxt_comparison.qualification: Solution/group stage only; different numerical objectives, grids, coverage, candidate schedules and architecture. All timing runs sequential after compilation/tests stop.

checks.minimal_rust_features: passed facade and Python crate with no-default-features
checks.ruff: passed lint and formatting, 806 Python files
checks.numpy_only_installed_wheel: passed native detection/row search/solution and bundled-filter HDF5 decoding

gates.original_known_group_python_parity: Historical strict final R1/coordinate parity failure unchanged; see native-coordinator-0.8-macos.json.

limitations: Exposed MgSiO3 regression example, supplied primitive orthorhombic cell and explicit acquisition/DAC assumptions; not blind validation.
Fast acceptance is numerical, not correctness/uniqueness proof. Only the inversion diagnostic and Pbca were phase-tested in successful fast runs; bounded omissions are explicit.
SHELXT and native code differ in architecture, processing, numerical objectives and hypothesis coverage.
No standalone single-crystal structural refinement or new Python/Dioptas discovery frontend.
All old protocol/trial data retained; failed audit harness path and development fixture/lint failures preserved externally.

cleanup.policy: Owned Cargo targets, extracted source rebuild and temporary documentation only. Preserved raw/source files, every trial, standalone binaries, distributions, criterion samples, logs, frozen protocols and historical receipts. Shared caches and other worktrees untouched.
